🚇 One day on the Prague Metro — Thursday 22 October 2026.

1,787 trains on the three lines A, B and C, opened in 1974, crossing under the Vltava. Each dot is a scheduled train on the real track, in its line colour. Morning peak: 97 trains on the move at 08:12.
